```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var marquee  = document.querySelector('.quarto-about-marquee');
  var contents = marquee && marquee.querySelector('.about-contents');
  var footer   = contents && contents.querySelector('.about-footer');
  var mainEl   = contents && contents.querySelector('main.content');

  // Find buttons paragraph via .btn — immune to sibling order changes
  var btnLink  = mainEl && mainEl.querySelector('a.btn');
  var buttonsP = btnLink && btnLink.closest('p');

  if (footer   && mainEl) contents.insertBefore(footer,   mainEl);
  if (buttonsP && mainEl) contents.insertBefore(buttonsP, mainEl);
  if (mainEl   && marquee) marquee.appendChild(mainEl);

  // Make profile photo clickable (opens full image in new tab)
  var imgEl = marquee && marquee.querySelector('.about-image-container img.about-image');
  if (imgEl) {
    var link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = imgEl.src;
    link.target = '_blank';
    link.rel = 'noopener';
    link.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;height:100%;';
    imgEl.parentNode.insertBefore(link, imgEl);
    link.appendChild(imgEl);
  }

  // Email link: copy address to clipboard + show "Copied!" toast
  var emailAnchor = marquee && marquee.querySelector('.about-links a[href^="mailto:"]');
  if (emailAnchor) {
    var toast = document.createElement('span');
    toast.textContent = 'Copied!';
    toast.style.cssText = [
      'position:fixed',
      'bottom:1.5rem',
      'left:50%',
      'transform:translateX(-50%)',
      'background:rgba(30,30,30,0.9)',
      'color:#fff',
      'font-size:0.78rem',
      'padding:5px 14px',
      'border-radius:20px',
      'pointer-events:none',
      'opacity:0',
      'transition:opacity 0.2s ease',
      'z-index:9999'
    ].join(';');
    document.body.appendChild(toast);

    emailAnchor.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var email = this.getAttribute('href').replace('mailto:', '');
      if (navigator.clipboard) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(email).catch(function () {});
      }
      toast.style.opacity = '1';
      clearTimeout(toast._t);
      toast._t = setTimeout(function () { toast.style.opacity = '0'; }, 2000);
    });
  }
});
</script>
```

<div class="hp-bio">
  <p class="hp-bio__greeting">Hi, I'm Aleksander Lupa — welcome to my ePortfolio.</p>

  <p>I'm a final-year Business Studies student at Dublin City University, specialising in Business Analytics and fluent in both English and Polish. Over the past few years I've been exploring how commercial thinking, data-driven analysis and real-world execution come together — from academic strategy projects to live freelance work and a mock Dragons' Den pitch.</p>

  <p>What defines me outside the classroom is just as relevant: I've built and shipped live client websites, co-developed a real product pitched to a mock investment panel, and planning to compete as a bodybuilder. I hold myself to high standards across everything I do.</p>

  <p>This portfolio brings together work that reflects both my academic development and personal ambitions — from data analysis and strategic frameworks to reflective writing, cross-cultural research and web design. Each piece represents a step in how I've learned to connect analytical rigour with practical execution and clear communication.</p>

  <div class="hp-bio__block">
    <p class="hp-bio__block-title">What this portfolio represents</p>

      <li>Freelance web design and development</li>
      <li>Cross-cultural awareness and international perspectives</li>
      <li>Competitive discipline and personal development</li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div class="hp-bio__block">

  </div>
</div>
